name: My Boss' Futanari Secret
source:
You are working overtime as usual.

But tonight, your Boss is here as well. 
Things take an unexpected turn when Boss asks you to do extra favors for her and you find about her secret.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4205740/My_Boss_Futanari_Secret/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
你像往常一样加班。

但今晚，你的老板也在这里。
当老板要求你为她做额外的事情并且你发现了她的秘密时，事情发生了意想不到的转变。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4205740/My_Boss_Futanari_Secret/]Steam[/url]]
